2.211.19
MapColorScale.Style
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The MapColorScale.Style element specifies style information for a MapColorScale. The
MapColorScale.Style element is optional. This element is of type Style.
The following is the parent element of the MapColorScale.Style element.
Parent elements
MapColorScale
The following is the XML Schema definition of the MapColorScale.Style element.
 <xsd:element name="Style" type="StyleType" minOccurs="0" />
